welcome_section.title: Software Engineer.
welcome_section.description: A full-stack developer with an interest in developing products.

who_am_i_section.title: From your idea to a working product.
who_am_i_section.introduction: I design, develop, and launch web and mobile products aligned with your business goals. From new product development to the evolution of existing platforms, my approach brings together user needs, technical requirements, and integration with your existing systems.
who_am_i_section.development_description: From design and application development to infrastructure and launch, I treat your product as a whole. After launch, I continue to support it with maintenance and new features.
who_am_i_section.ai_products_description: I integrate AI into your product to build features that help your users and workflows that reduce repetitive work.
who_am_i_section.agentic_coding_description: I use AI tools and coding agents to accelerate development while taking responsibility for architecture, code review, and quality control.

process_section.title_regular_before_break: Three Steps To Build A Product
process_section.design_card_description: The initial step involves exploring and defining brand identities, crafting distinctive visual styles that help companies stand out in their market with a unique character and presence.
process_section.design_card_alt: Screenshot of an app that built by Erinç Polat
process_section.development_card_description: As the process shifts from design to development, concepts are transformed into digital experiences, with websites, apps, and products crafted to convey compelling brand stories.
process_section.development_card_alt: Screenshots of the web designs that Erinç Polat made
process_section.improvement_card_description: Analytics support, service containerization, SEO/ASO, store testing and tracking setup, server configuration, and ongoing improvements are implemented.
